gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM); Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG); Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 4; Diffuse Hemispheric Glioma, H3 G34-Mutant; Gliosarcoma of Brain

Eligible diagnoses include: Glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype), Gliosarcoma, Diffuse Midline Glioma (H3 K27-altered), diffuse hemispheric glioma (H3 G34-mutant), diffuse pediatric-type high-grade glioma (H3 and IDH-wildtype), Astrocytoma IDH-mutant (Grade 4)

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a single-arm open-label phase 1 dose escalation/expansion trial assessing the safety and efficacy of concurrent intrathecal azacitidine and intrathecal nivolumab in recurrent high-grade glioma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Documented recurrence by diagnostic biopsy or contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) per RANO 2.0 criteria

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess biomarkers for immunologic and epigenetic effects of therapy: Changes in CSF and blood immunological profiling by flow cytometry, cytokine/chemokine analysis. Changes in circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) analysis in CSF
circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) biomarkers (quantification, DNA methylation)

role_evidence.quote: Intrathecal azacitidine will be dose-escalated with 4 dose levels (5, 10, 20, 40 mg) using a 3+3 design.

agents.drug_class_hint: hypomethylating agent (DNMT inhibitor), approved for myelodysplastic syndromes; given intrathecally

role_evidence.quote: Intrathecal nivolumab will be given at a flat dose of 40 mg

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor monoclonal antibody; given intrathecally

role_evidence.quote: MRI Brain and full Spine (with and without contrast) will be performed prior to enrollment.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CSF ctDNA quantification and DNA methylation

source_quote.quote: circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) biomarkers (quantification, DNA methylation)

coder_notes: Mixed high-grade glioma trial (GBM IDH-wildtype, gliosarcoma, DMG H3K27-altered, DHG H3 G34, paediatric-type HGG, IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma); ages 13+. IDH, H3 K27 and H3 G34 appear only as definitions of eligible diagnoses (any of them allowed), not as entry requirements, so no eligibility biomarker rows. Both azacitidine and nivolumab are investigational in the single arm and given intrathecally (new_route). CSF ctDNA methylation is planned to capture epigenetic effects of therapy, linked to azacitidine (DNMT inhibitor) as pharmacodynamic; immune profiling (flow cytometry, cytokines) relates to nivolumab but is not a tumour molecular biomarker, so not listed as a biomarker row. MRI contrast is a registered diagnostic test, listed as diagnostic_agent; agent not named in the record.
